content: Petro ahanûla abagula b’Ekleziya
Abagula
bali muli mwe, alagi ihano mbahire, nie mugula akabo, nie na câliho c’amababale ga Kristu, nie nanayish’ishangira irenge lyânabonekane
Muyâbule obusò bwa Nyamuzinda mwahizirwemwo, arhali nk’abasêzîbwe, ci n’omurhima gwinyu gwoshi, nk’oku Nyamuzinda alonzize, arhali omu kulonza obunguke bubî, ci n’omurhima nkana.
Murhazidoheraga abamwahîrwe mpu mubarhegeke, ci mubè lwîganyo lw’obusò.
N’amango Lungere w’abangere acîyêrekana, mwahâbwa ishungwè ly’irenge lirhakasherêra.
Ahanûla emisole n’abandi bemêzi
Ninyu mwe misole, mukâyumva abagula. Mweshi muhwinje omwambalo gw’obwîrhôhye omu kuyôrha n’abinyu; bulya abacîbonyi Nyamuzinda kucîka abacîka ci abîrhôhye bo ashobôza engalo yâge.
Kuziga mucîrhohye embere z’okuboko kugala-byoshi kwa Nyamuzinda, lyo ammukuza omu mango ga­kwânîne
Amalagîrire ginyu goshi mugahire omu maboko gâge, bulya kushîbirira ayôrha ammushîbirira.
Mulange olugero munabè masù! Omushombanyi winyu, Shetani, nka ntale yaluluma, adwîrhe azunguluka-zunguluka, mpu alonze oyu amira.
Mumuhagalike n’obuzibu bw’obuyêmêre bwinyu, munamanye oku ago malibuko go ganadwîrhe galibuza bene winyu bali omu igulu.

Na hano mubà mwamâlibuzibwa kasanzi katyunguli, Nyamuzinda w’enshôkano zoshi wammuhamagalaga okushangîra irenge lyâge ly’ensiku n’amango muli Kristu Yezu, yêne âmmuyumanyanya âmmukomeze, âmmuzibuhya anammujire ntadundagana.
Kuli ye irenge n’obuhashe emyâka n’emyâka. Amen!
Amahano mazinda, omusingo n’obwangà
Mmuyandikîre ebi binwa bisungunu n’okuboko kwa Silvano, mwene wîrhu mbona nk’akwânîne okucîkubagirwa, nti mmuhanûle nampamîrize oku eyo yo nshôkano y’okuli ya Nyamuzinda: muyisêremwo buzibu.
Ekleziya eri e Babiloni
, ntôle akinyu, emmulamusize; na mugala
wâni Marko naye a­mmulamusize.
Mulamusanye n’ehinûnugurho hy’obuzigire. Obuholo kuli mwe mweshi muli Kristu!

5, 13 E Babiloni: e Roma, ngasi washâbire Yeruzalemu, Abayahudi banamuhè erya Babiloni, bulya Babiloni ye wali murhanzi okushâba Yeruzalemu.
